fixed.explanation: The three tolerance checks in _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance only reject values below zero, so zero is accepted, but the error text said "positive". I changed all three messages (timedelta, integer and float branches) to "tolerance must be non-negative". The checks are unchanged.

query.intent: The as-of merge validation of the tolerance argument (in _get_merge_keys / _validate_tolerance style checks for timedelta, integer and float keys) raises a MergeError whose message says tolerance must be positive; the message should say it must be non-negative, while the check (reject only values < 0) stays unchanged.
query.symptom: Passing a negative tolerance to merge_asof raises a MergeError saying the tolerance must be positive, which wrongly implies zero is invalid, though zero is accepted.

history.analysis: _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance has three branches (timedelta, integer, float) that each raise MergeError("tolerance must be positive") when tolerance < 0. The check is correct, but the message is wrong. Changing the three messages to "tolerance must be non-negative" fixes the issue.
